title: A retried chain reports current-attempt timing without changing site generation
steps: Create a failed site brief two hours old. Accept its retry through restartBrief, then read the chain build table while it runs and finish its base-site step.
expect: An accepted retry stamps attemptStartedAt and retains created_at and its WO retry action.
The table reports the attempt start and elapsed minutes; the base-site duration excludes the earlier failed attempt.
Rows without an attempt stamp retain their existing timing behavior.
fence: restartBrief attempt stamp and chain timing readers

tests: a retried chain measures its current attempt without changing the site generation
a retried chain base-site duration excludes the previous failed attempt
